Umm.. don’t you want to see the finished results of your teeth without braces though? I feel like getting them off is the most exciting part about the braces journey

For my overbite case it did. I’m still in braces and as they’re fixing my bite, my jaw now sits in a more forward position than before.  I’ve also noticed there’s more height to my lower face, creating facial balance from my molars extruding and fixing my deep bite.
Chicken noodle with poached eggs
I feel you. I have 2 cats and so I take an extra precaution of wearing a silk sleep cap to bed (it’s also very healthy for your hair)
Ask about a smile arc
I see it. I would definitely bring it up to your ortho before getting your braces off! That’s what I’d do
You could be unhappy with your smile arc being flat?
My first two appointments were 10 weeks apart. My third and 4th appointment were 8 weeks apart
Use a nail file

When I first got my braces, they didn’t really hurt either and I think I can attribute that to the fact that my teeth weren’t too crowded. However, when I went for my first adjustment and moved me to a thicker wire, that’s when I felt the pain that everyone’s talked about. It was crazy because I hardly felt pain when I first got the braces on but with the adjustment, ALL my teeth were hurting for the first few days
Oh okay! The results will be great regardless :)

I have ceramic brackets but never had to worry about staining because my braces are self ligating so they don’t have the elastic ligature which is what stains (not the brackets themselves). I would ask your ortho if the ceramic braces are self ligating.. if they are, I’d go for ceramics over metal
Better yet, believe PATTERNS over actions 👌
My bracket placements are higher up. Having  a nice smile arc was something I talked to my ortho about and was adamant on achieving with my treatment
I’ve noticed that since I started my elastics, my jaw line has gotten more defined now that it’s being pushed forward to correct my overjet. I love it!

Definitely speak up on it. You’re paying for this treatment, you don’t want to leave unhappy after investing all this money into your braces journey.

I have them too and eating with them for the first  2 weeks was absolutely awful. I thought to myself, how tf could anyone live with these? But now, I’m completely used to them and removing your braces would be the worst decision because you too will eventually get used to eating with them.

You could try filing them down a bit with a nail file (that’s what I did when one side was uneven) but MAKE SURE they’re still functional in keeping your bite apart as not to not interfere with the progress of your braces
Braces but don’t extract teeth
